landing_smoke.evidence: Failed with ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED at localhost:3000 because no dev server was running; production smoke not run in this local slice.

observations: WaitlistForm is now a contact section, not a /waitlist route.
LiveDemo says no login required but its full click target links to /login?mode=demo&example=syria-2026.
Legacy landing components still contain Syria-specific proof/case copy.

findings.title: Primary demo funnel is not the architecture-specified public /demo/syria-2024 route.
findings.evidence: Production /demo/syria-2024 returns 307 to /login?mode=demo&example=syria-2026; LiveDemo and layout CTAs also target login demo URLs.
findings.remediationSketch: Implement or explicitly defer the signed-out public demo route; then point the primary landing CTA to it.

findings.title: Canonical entry/legal routes in the audit prompt are missing.
findings.evidence: /waitlist, /login/callback, and /legal/{privacy,terms,security,data-retention} return 404; only /privacy and /terms are live.
findings.remediationSketch: Add route redirects or pages so canonical URLs resolve with documented status codes.

findings.title: CTA hierarchy does not match one primary Try demo plus one secondary Join waitlist.
findings.evidence: Nav exposes Sign In plus Try an example; contact section exposes email/tacitus links; no /waitlist route exists.
findings.remediationSketch: After route decision, normalize landing CTAs to one primary demo link and one secondary waitlist/contact link.

findings.title: Landing is improved but still has Syria-heavy legacy copy and assets.
findings.evidence: Syria-specific copy remains in hero-quadrant-tour, syria-case-proof, grounding-backbone, problem-section, and related constants.
findings.remediationSketch: Keep Syria as one example case, but rebalance landing visuals around the workbench, ontologies, tools marketplace, graph, and Memo Studio.

findings.title: Marketplace and Memo Studio are not explicit enough for the actual built product.
findings.evidence: Current sections include SixSteps, ExampleCasesGallery, Dialectica, LiveDemo, BuiltFor, Trust, Pricing, and Contact; no explicit 16-tool marketplace or Memo Studio callout section.
findings.remediationSketch: Add product-accurate sections for 16 tools and Memo Studio using real screenshots/assets after plan approval.

findings.title: Lighthouse targets are not proven in this audit.
findings.evidence: No lighthouserc.json/lh:ci script; local landing smoke failed because no dev server was running.
findings.remediationSketch: Add LHCI or run documented Lighthouse against production after canonical demo/route decisions.
